headline: Biden order directs a review of federal rules on sex discrimination in schools, including sexual orientation and gender identity.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order sets a policy that students should be able to learn in schools free from discrimination based on sex, including sexual orientation and gender identity. It likely directs the Education Department to review existing federal rules and guidance on this topic and consider changes. No summary was provided, so specific details are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Students at schools that receive federal funding
who_it_affects.how: Federal policy on how they are protected from sex discrimination, including based on sexual orientation or gender identity, may be reviewed and changed.

who_it_affects.group: Schools, colleges, and universities that receive federal funding
who_it_affects.how: They may face updated federal rules or guidance on preventing and handling sex discrimination.
It is likely tasked with reviewing and possibly revising its rules and guidance in this area.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 8, 2021; any rule changes would come later through agency action.
